cases.name: Ana Walshe
cases.about: She was a corporate real estate manager. She worked for a real estate firm in Washington, DC – reportedly split her time between Massachusetts, where her husband and children lived, and Washington, where she had a home for her work.
cases.narrative: Authorities said they found evidence he killed and dismembered her and gruesomely disposed of her remains.
